method.action_space: 9 discrete actions: fold, check/call, six pot-fraction raises, all-in

exp003_variance_reduction.notes: Mirrored deals duplicate self-play shuffled deals with seats swapped; all-in EV replaces sampled runout payoff with exact EV when cheap, otherwise deterministic bounded-K runout EV.

h2_showdown_critic_targets.estimand: conditional line value holding terminal committed chips fixed

method.network: pseudo-Siamese card/action/extra branches with policy and value heads
method.opponent_pool_deviation: latest-K FIFO is an ablation/deviation from paper K-best/ELO survivor selection.

postflop_action_prior.scope: postflop trainable decisions only; targets renormalized over legal classes

preflop_action_prior.scope: preflop trainable decisions only; targets renormalized over legal classes

bb_vs_open.scope: preflop rows with exactly one prior opponent aggressive action; targets renormalized over legal classes

preflop_context_action_priors.interaction: When a context prior is active, the global preflop prior is applied only to other preflop rows so context targets do not double-count.

sb_open.scope: preflop rows with no prior street actions; targets renormalized over legal classes

reference.paper: Zhao et al., AlphaHoldem: High-Performance Artificial Intelligence for Heads-Up No-Limit Poker via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning, AAAI 2022

hand_gradient_noise.caveat: Descriptive simple noise scale, not an optimal batch estimate or poker-strength claim. Whole hands clustered, but full-batch advantage normalization and adaptive league induce dependencies. Entropy boost is fixed at selected full-batch mean for all diagnostic groups; actual PPO is unchanged.
